title: 第23章 黑市第24章 养魂木
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 一下子砍了这么多，摊主当然很心痛，想再议价，却看巫未央已经站起来随时要走的样子，连忙拉住她，“给你给你。”
好不容易逮到一个大冤种，摊主想着能挣回一点是一点。
这本阵法图包含了所有低阶阵法以及五个常见的中阶阵法，珍宝阁售卖价格是两百上品灵石，价格其实已经算是低廉，因为一旦学会，一个中阶阵法的阵盘就基本能卖出十块上品灵石的价格。
摊主就是看上了这一点，才买的阵法图，只是阵法极需天赋这个说法还真不是谣言，那是真需要啊。
摊主日日夜夜钻研了两个月，道心就破碎了。
终于受不了要把阵法图卖了回回血。
但他在这坊市摆了三天的摊子，什么东西都卖掉了，就阵法图卖不掉，因为大家都很有自知之明。
显得买阵法图的摊主更蠢了，他也终于知道珍宝阁为什么要用低价卖阵法图了。
专门坑他这种贪心的傻子。
巫未央拿出四十块上品灵石，这已经是她资产的三分之一了。
她安慰自己，一切都是为了变得更强。
就这样，两人都心痛地完成了交易。
买完阵法图之后，天已经昏黄一片即将入夜，虽然坊市没有要散的意思，但巫未央已经花了很多灵石，为了防止自己把灵石都花光，她掉头出了坊市。
走出坊市不久，陈沫就出现了。
“走吧，我已经租好房子，我们要在这里呆一段时间。”
至于为什么，那当然是黑市还有半个月才开启。
陈沫租的房子在山川城外围，是两室一厅的小院子，环境很是谧静。
两人进院子逛了一圈，最后坐在主厅里。
“今日可买了东西？老夫替你掌掌眼。”
闻言，巫未央将自己买的东西都掏了出来。
看着堆满整张桌面的材料，陈沫顿了一下，这丫头跟谁学的，怎么这么舍得花钱，他还以为什么都不会买呢。
但话已经放出来了，面对巫未央亮晶晶的眼眸，陈沫只得一件一件看了过去。
“假货！”
“垃圾！”
“一般，多少价格买的？五百下品？贵了。”
“还行。”
“又是垃圾。”
“还是垃圾。”
巫未央听着，心越来越凉，她已经很谨慎了，买的东西却还是有一半是垃圾，只有少数几样算是可以。
她坐在椅子上恍恍惚惚，怀疑人生。
“嗯？阵法图？”
陈沫看到最后一样东西，“你要学阵法？”
巫未央回过神，“是的，掌门您不是说阵法可融入器纹里么，我想着学一学。”
陈沫摸了摸胡须，“老夫也只略微学过一些简单的阵法，恐不能教你啊。”
陈沫比较擅长法印和符文。
巫未央抿抿唇，打开阵法图，看着书应当能学会吧？
content_en:
After cutting off so much at once, the stall owner was certainly heartbroken and wanted to negotiate the price, but seeing that Wu Weiyang had already stood up and looked like she was about to leave at any moment, he quickly grabbed her and said, "Here you go, here you go."
After finally catching a big culprit, the stall owner thought he could make some money back.
This formation chart contains all low-level formations and five common mid-level formations. The price of the treasure pavilion is two hundred high-grade spiritual stones. The price is actually low, because once you learn it, a mid-level formation disk can basically sell for ten high-grade spiritual stones.
The stall owner took a fancy to this and bought the formation map. However, the saying that formation requires talent is really not a rumor, it is really needed.
The stall owner studied day and night for two months, and his Taoist heart was broken.
Finally I couldn't stand it anymore and wanted to sell the formation map to get some blood.
But he set up a stall in this market for three days and sold everything except the formation diagram, because everyone is very self-aware.
It seemed that the stall owner who bought the formation map was even more stupid. He finally knew why Zhenbao Pavilion sold the formation map at a low price.
Specially designed to trick greedy fools like him.
Wu Weiyang took out forty high-grade spiritual stones, which was already one-third of her assets.
She comforted herself that everything was to become stronger.
In this way, both of them heartbrokenly completed the deal.
After buying the formation map, it was already dusk and it was about to fall into the night. Although Fangshi had no intention of leaving, Wu Weiyang had already spent a lot of spirit stones. In order to prevent herself from spending all the spirit stones, she turned around and left Fangshi.
Not long after leaving Fangshi, Chen Mo appeared.
"Let's go, I've rented a house and we're going to stay here for a while."
As for the reason, of course it was because the black market would only open in half a month.
The house Chen Mo rented was on the outskirts of Shanchuan City. It was a small courtyard with two bedrooms and one living room, and the environment was very quiet.
The two walked around the courtyard and finally sat in the main hall.
"Did you buy anything today? I'll keep an eye on you."
Hearing this, Wu Weiyang took out all the things he bought.
Looking at the materials piled all over the table, Chen Mo paused for a moment. Who did this girl learn from? How could she be so willing to spend money? He thought she didn't know how to buy anything.
But the words had already been spoken. Facing Wu Weiyang's shining eyes, Chen Mo could only look at them one by one.
"Fake!"
"Trash!"
"Generally, how much did you buy it for? Five hundred for the lowest quality? It's expensive."
"It's okay."
"It's rubbish again."
"Still garbage."
"..."
As Wu Weiyang listened, her heart grew colder and colder. She was already very cautious, but half of the things she bought were still garbage, and only a few were considered acceptable.
She sat in a chair and was in a trance, doubting life.
"Huh? Formation diagram?"
Chen Mo saw the last thing, "Do you want to learn the formation?"
Wu Weiyang came back to her senses, "Yes, Master, didn't you say that the formation can be integrated into the weapon pattern? I want to learn it."
Chen Mo touched his beard and said, "I have only learned some simple formations, so I may not be able to teach you."
Chen Mo is better at seals and runes.
Wu Weiyang pursed her lips and opened the formation chart. She should be able to learn it by reading the book, right?
